transcript: Remove the things that lead you nowhere. When you remove the things that lead you nowhere, you're creating rules. You're creating the opportunity to know when it's time to create with quality and when to use quantity as a route to move forward. When we look at our program for what it is currently, it gives us the opportunity to readjust our program that we want for the future. There is a fine line in between where we are now and where we're going, and it takes minimal steps to get there, but observation and awareness gets us to the other side.
